references.text: This verse describes the fulfillment of the command in verse 30, where Moses actually took one out of every fifty from the half-tribe of Israel and gave them to the Levites.
The Levites are described as those who keep watch at the tabernacle and take care of everything belonging to the Lord's dwelling.
The Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony and keep watch at the Lord's dwelling.
Describes the role of the Levites as servants at the tabernacle and their responsibility to keep watch.
The service of the Levites at the tent of meeting and their watchkeeping are described here.
Refers to the gatekeepers and the Levites who kept watch at the Lord's house and the tabernacle.
The Levites shall be responsible for the service in the house and all the work that is to be done there.
